run_generate_profile_shell_scripts: run the script to generate Nsight Systems profiling shell scripts for Habitat-lab DDPPO PointNav training
review_generate_profile_shell_scripts: review the profiling shell script generator to understand configurable options like capture step range and slurm settings
refactor_generate_profile_shell_scripts: refactor the profiling script generator to support a different Habitat-lab program or profiling tool path
summarize_generate_profile_shell_scripts: summarize the profiling script generator which creates slurm and local shell scripts for Nsight Systems capture
test_generate_profile_shell_scripts: test the profiling script generator by running it and verifying the generated shell scripts are valid
